Boggle

Shake the tray to start

How to play

Goal

Find as many words as you can in the 4×4 grid before time runs out. You play against the computer, which finds its own words on the same grid.

Making a word

  • Chain letters that touch, including diagonally.
  • A cube can be used once per word.
  • Words need at least 3 letters. Plurals and other forms are fine; names are not.
  • Drag across the cubes and let go to submit. Or tap letters one at a time, then tap the last letter again (or press Submit). On a keyboard, just type and press Enter.
  • The Qu cube counts as two letters.

Scoring

  • 3–4 letters: 1 point
  • 5 letters: 2 points
  • 6 letters: 3 points
  • 7 letters: 5 points
  • 8 or more: 11 points

Any word both you and the computer found scores for neither of you.

Notes

The dictionary is a large Scrabble-style list, so some unusual words count. Hint shows where a word starts, up to three times a game.

Stats

Stats are saved on this device.

Settings

Changes apply to the next round.
